cards.title: The most urgent thing first
cards.body:
An AI agent picks its most urgent task; an event system fires the earliest timer; Dijkstra settles the closest town. All of these need "give me the smallest" over and over.

A **binary heap** stores a tree in a plain array: children of index `i` live at `2i+1` and `2i+2`. No pointers at all.
